active.recoveredThrough: VI. THE IMPERIAL ART OF SLEEPING BADLY — complete through Broussard's two-hour-twelve-minute rest cycle, visual contact with the Hesperant Vale, and his renewed unease on approach.

active.currentEndpoint: Verbatim Google-source recovery now includes Chapters I–VI in full. Chapter VI establishes Broussard's explicit fatigue-management doctrine, practical delegation, veteran ability to sleep under poor field conditions, Jalesthesian's support for functional command rather than performative zeal, and visual contact with the damaged Hesperant Vale. Chapters VII–X remain present in the Google source but uncommitted. The later deep-index telemetry falsification, predator attack, convoy return and reader-only Genestealer reveal remain authoritative authorial continuity beyond the currently observed Google draft and must not be invented as recovered prose.
active.nextSlice: Recover Chapter VII verbatim from the Google working draft. Before fresh prose, continue sequentially through Chapters VII–X and maintain character-state updates after each substantial recovered slice.
constraints: Fourteen-second telemetry gap is a surface anomaly, not the main plot hole.
Deep-indexed older telemetry was falsified to conceal the freighter's true port of origin.
Hesperant Vale crew is secretly compromised by Genestealer influence.
Genestealer hybrids are hidden among loose produce bins in the forward holds.
Broussard's detachment successfully returns the damaged freighter to the convoy after fighting additional High Presidio predators.
The reader sees the hidden Xenos travesty continuing beneath the apparent successful rescue.
Recover Google source sequentially and verbatim before fresh expansion.
